mapper.select: SELECT id, name, status, chunk_count AS "chunkCount" FROM kb_knowledge_base WHERE status IN ('READY', 'INDEXING') AND owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT owner_id FROM kb_knowledge_base WHERE id = #{kbId}
SELECT type, dimension, enabled FROM llm_model WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT value FROM sys_setting WHERE key = #{key}
SELECT id FROM kb_knowledge_base WHERE name = #{name} AND owner_id = #{ownerId}

INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_base (name, description, embedding_model_id, rerank_model_id, chunk_size, chunk_overlap, separators, retrieval_mode, vector_weight, bm25_weight, rerank_enabled, top_k, score_threshold, owner_id, visibility, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{embeddingModelId}, #{rerankModelId}, #{chunkSize}, #{chunkOverlap}, CAST(#{separatorsJson} AS jsonb), #{retrievalMode}, #{vectorWeight}, #{bm25Weight}, #{rerankEnabled}, #{topK}, #{scoreThreshold}, #{ownerId}, 'PRIVATE', 'EMPTY') RETURNING id

SELECT kb.id, kb.name, kb.description, kb.embedding_model_id AS "embeddingModelId", em.name AS "embeddingModelName", kb.rerank_enabled AS "rerankEnabled", kb.rerank_model_id AS "rerankModelId", kb.retrieval_mode AS "retrievalMode", kb.top_k AS "topK", kb.score_threshold AS "scoreThreshold", kb.vector_weight AS "vectorWeight", kb.bm25_weight AS "bm25Weight", kb.owner_id AS "ownerId", u.username AS "ownerName", kb.visibility, kb.status, kb.doc_count AS "docCount", kb.chunk_count AS "chunkCount", kb.created_at AS "createdAt", kb.updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM kb_knowledge_base kb JOIN llm_model em ON em.id = kb.embedding_model_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = kb.owner_id WHERE kb.id = #{kbId}

SELECT d.id AS id, d.kb_id AS "kbId", d.name AS name, d.file_type AS "fileType", d.file_size AS "fileSize", d.char_count AS "charCount", d.chunk_count AS "chunkCount", d.status AS status, d.error_msg AS "errorMsg", d.created_at AS "createdAt", d.updated_at AS "updatedAt", CASE WHEN d.status = 'READY' THEN 100 WHEN d.status = 'FAILED' THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE(c.total_chunks, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE LEAST(99, (c.embedded_chunks * 100 / c.total_chunks)::int) END AS progress FROM kb_document d LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS total_chunks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL) AS embedded_chunks FROM kb_chunk WHERE kb_id = d.kb_id AND document_id = d.id ) c ON true WHERE d.kb_id = #{kbId} AND d.name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND d.status = #{status} ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC
